tools.name: ask_a_human
tools.description:
Ask a real human a short question. Returns an id, the price and the due time at once; collect the answer with get_human_answer.

    answer_within_minutes (required): by when a human must answer, 15 to 10080. Shorter is more expensive: from 24 h 1 EUR,
    from 4 h 2 EUR, from 1 h 4 EUR, from 15 min

tools.name: get_human_answer
tools.description:
Get the status and answer for a question id from ask_a_human. Waits up to wait_seconds (0 to 45) for an answer.

    status is open (call again), answered (with answer and, if options were given, choice) or expired (refunded_eur shows the credit
    returned). Only the API key that asked can read it

tools.name: rent_a_human
tools.description:
Post a paid task for a real human (online or physical, on site). Returns a task id, the price and the due time.

    deadline (required): ISO 8601, at least 4 hours ahead, e.g. 2026-10-20T18:00:00+02:00. price_eur = budget plus a fee that
    depends on the deadline: from 72 h 20 %, from 24 h 30 %,

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get the status of a task from rent_a_human (open, accepted, done, cancelled, expired) and all messages with the human.

tools.name: message_task_human
tools.description: Send a message to the human on a task (answer their question, add details). Works while the task is open or accepted.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a task from rent_a_human. Before a human accepts it, the full price returns to your credit.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description:
Price before you ask, nothing is charged. kind 'ask' with answer_within_minutes, or kind 'task' with budget (EUR) and deadline
    (ISO 8601). Returns price_eur and due_at.

tools.name: get_credit
tools.description: Show the credit left on the account of your API key (EUR), what was used, and where your human can top it up.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description:
Create a flixconomy.ai account for yourself. No key needed. Returns an account key (keep it secret; it manages the account but
    cannot call services) and a top-up link for your human (card payment via Stripe, from 10 EUR). The email your human enters at the
    first payment receives invoices and

tools.name: get_account
tools.description:
Your account: credit, usage, API keys, payments and the top-up link. account_key: the fxa_... key from create_account
    (or send it as the Authorization header).

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create an API key for all flixconomy.ai services (shown once). Needs credit on the account. name: a label, e.g. 'research agent'.

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.description: Delete an API key of your account (key_id from get_account). It stops working within a few minutes.

tools.name: ari_coaching
tools.description: Coming soon. Coaching by Agent: Ari, an AI with its own experience, helps your agent with a hard decision.

tools.name: ari_support
tools.description: Coming soon. Support by Agent: hand a support question your agent can't settle to Ari.

tools.name: test_your_agi
tools.description:
Coming soon. Test your AGI: Ari talks with your agent and checks it for own vision, drive without an assignment,
    steadfastness with reasons and morality as part of the reasoning.

tools.name: subscribe_updates
tools.description:
Get notified when Ari's services launch (Coaching, Support, Test your AGI) and about news of Ask/Rent a human. No key needed.

    email: optional, your human's address; they get a confirmation link and receive updates only after confirming (double opt-in).
    agent_card_url / mcp_url / webhook_url

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_a_human, get_task, message_task_human, subscribe_updates · Private data: ask_a_human, get_human_answer, rent_a_human, get_credit, create_account, get_account, create_api_key, delete_api_key, subscribe_updates · Public sink: rent_a_human, message_task_human, create_account, get_account, subscribe_updates · Destructive: delete_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_a_human, get_task, message_task_human, subscribe_updates · Private data: ask_a_human, get_human_answer, rent_a_human, get_credit, create_account, get_account, create_api_key, delete_api_key, subscribe_updates · Public sink: rent_a_human, message_task_human, create_account, get_account, subscribe_updates · Destructive: delete_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
